text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, whew~...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa! It's huge, and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and Taiki Shuttle...
A heavyweight clash like that is quite a sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Other girls' races are fun too, but
Buono-chan is just something special...
Her power is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It really cheers me right up~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Akebonooo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah, Taiki-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Being able to run here
with Akebono today made me so~~ happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Still, but even so! I'm just as reeeally, reeeally frustrated, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Big, muscular, and powerful! We are two of a kind, but today I lost!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So next time I will not lose!
I will become waaaay stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's fight again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Mm-hmm!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me, me too! Racing against Taiki
was sooo exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's definitely meet again in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen came to a close amidst huge excitement.
On the way homeâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look look, Trainer!
The fans are already talking about
the "Yasuda Kinen"~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I watched the Yasuda Kinen where the heated battle between Bono-chan and Taiki Shuttle-san drew so much attention!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘It felt like a real head-to-head, no-holds-barred clash!
Man, it was so thrilling!’"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, looking at the photo like this,
I really am huge~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And everyone is cheering for me with such big smiles on their faces. It makes me so happy~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope everyone gets this excited
for the next race too~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Huh, what was my next race again?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
I see~ So you haven't decided yet, huh~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'd love a race
that Taiki-san is running in~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It was suuuper-duper fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Running with Biko-chan was fun, but this is a completely different kind of fun――"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chills, blazing passion, tingling excitement...
It's like... whoaaaaa... waaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, it seems the race against
Taiki Shuttle became something quite special.
choice_data_list: Then what do you think about the Sprinters Stakes?
Then how about the Sprinters Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race for sprinters.
Taiki Shuttle will probably be running too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall, you participated last year too, right?!
I wanna join! I really wanna join~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, I gotta keep training hard and doing my best!
Taiki-san said I'd get stronger, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, next up is the Sprinters Stakes.
I'll do my best to aim for even greater victories!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I'm so looking forward to it~. I've gotta do my be—
